status: FROZEN - edits require a new gate directory; the runner refuses a changed manifest
notes: The runner records a sha256 of this exact file with every result.
provenance_notes: Baseline optimizer is Adam/wd=0 (native recipe): the Super-Tuning paper (arXiv:2607.09287) states 'Training uses Adam with weight decay 0', and Adam is this repo's pipeline default. OCFDA keeps B1's AdamW/wd=0.
Super variant is the Wanda BottomK mask ('super-bottom'): the paper's headline Super rows are BottomK (55.46% vs TopK below it, Llama-3.2-1B 3-epoch).
Super calibration is 128xC4, seed 228 (paper canonical; allenai/c4 public, pinned shards verified). Deterministic mask; cached in loaders_cache after first build.

selection_rule.scope: held-out Math17K validation split only (120 examples, split seed 42)
selection_rule.aggregation: mean NLL across runs at (method, lr); selection phase uses one train seed so this is a single value
selection_rule.tie: exact B1 rule: 0.5%-within-best-NLL prefers the lower LR (shared implementation with B1)
selection_rule.forbidden: benchmark test scores (accuracy/PPL/NLL on the six heldout sets) must not participate in LR selection

ocfda_reference.loader: read-only; verify ownership triple, trainable == 5603328, and rounded scores before use

exploratory.label: exploratory - never a comparator in gate statistics

gate_rule.primary: three-seed mean macro accuracy per method
gate_rule.pass: OCFDA within 2.0pp of the strongest baseline mean or better -> methods-paper route
gate_rule.rescue: if accuracy fails, OCFDA needs >=25% lower peak training memory or optimizer-state footprint vs every baseline -> tradeoff-paper route
gate_rule.fail: neither holds -> stop the competitive-PEFT paper route (geometry/analysis route stays alive)

gate_rules: Existing aligned OCFDA runs are read-only references; never retrain them.
Numerically identical seed values across methods do NOT imply equivalent random objects; report independent per-method means, never paired cross-method deltas.
The existing LoRA sentinel is ambient context only; it must not enter selection or the final comparison.
Final summary reports three-seed means AND individual scores per method.
No code may choose hyperparameters from benchmark test scores.
